Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (native inspect-revise protocol); not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

Observed (24 reference samples, 0-23.98 s): a letterboxed first-person WWI battlefield sequence. Grey misty ruined village with a flag and fires (0-1 s); green-gas field with a near wall, windowed ruin and fire (2-4 s); dark rubble slope with a running soldier and an explosion (5.2 s); soldier ahead with an explosion behind him (6.25 s); a rhomboid tank crossing over the player, who raises hands, then a pistol and the tank receding left with a Union flag beyond (7.3-10.4 s); a walk up a mound past a flagpole to ruins (11.5-13.6 s); entering a ruined house and aiming out of a window (14.6-18.8 s); green-fog dead-tree field, a shell burst with flying debris, and the player dropping low near water (19.8-24 s).

Geometry: boxes for ruins and walls (window openings built from box segments), tapered cylinders for dead trees, flattened spheres for rubble mounds, cones for fires, an extruded rhomboid plus boxes for the tank, articulated box soldiers (hips, knees, shoulders, elbows), a pole plus layered thin boxes for the Union flag. There is a gradient sky dome shader with a sun glow, distance fog that changes per shot, and letterbox bars matching the source.

Articulation: the first-person rifle or pistol, both gloved hands and the forearms are camera children, keyed from the reference screen positions of muzzle and grip at each sample. The 7.3 s pose has both hands raised. The soldiers have running cycles. The flags wave. The explosions expand and throw sparks. The shell-burst debris follows deterministic ballistic paths.

Camera and timing: 8 shots. The inferred cut times are 1.57, 4.70, 5.73, 6.78, 10.95, 14.08 and 19.30 s, placed at midpoints between samples where the location changes. Within each shot the camera position, yaw, pitch and roll are Hermite-interpolated through per-sample keys. The 1280x720 resolution, 60 fps and 24 s timeline are used directly.

Inference (not observed): the motion between samples, the exact cut times, whether 0-1.05 s and 4.7-6.8 s are continuous shots, the tank's heading and path, and the soldiers' facing.

Render feedback: none received yet (initial round).
